consequence.statement: The CRD bump is a mandatory first step: before migrating external-secrets to v0.16.1, the operator must apply the v0.16.1 CRD bundle (kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml) and verify no error occurs; an operator who does nothing migrates the controller without the required CRD update.
consequence.remediation: Run kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml, verify no error occurs, and only then upgrade the external-secrets deployment to v0.16.1.

assertion.statement: When upgrading, environments whose CRDs are installed separately from the chart must first bump the CRDs by applying the v0.16.1 CRD bundle (kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml), verify no error occurs, and only then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.
